description.value: Palisades Cafe is a community-focused cafe in Houston, BC, situated just off the Highway 16 corridor — a key artery for touring cyclists crossing northern BC on the Yellowhead route. Founded by Liz Watson, it serves ethically sourced locally roasted coffee and espresso, fresh daily lunch specials, homemade soups and salads, and a wide selection of gluten-free and vegan baked goods. The cafe doubles as a cultural hub hosting arts initiatives and community events, and also operates a mobile Cafe Cruiser for off-site catering.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and content-rich, confirming the cafe at 3384 9th Street, Houston, BC is open and operational; the phone number 1(778) 642-3887 appears on the website but was absent from OSM. The site explicitly states 'We specialize in offering an abundance of gluten free and vegan treats' and lists 'grab-and-go snacks' among services, supporting those amenity fields. Bike parking, washrooms, water refill, and WiFi are not mentioned anywhere in the website content, so OSM's internet_access tag cannot be confirmed and all those fields remain null.
